programme.desc: ITunes Festival, is an annual music festival that takes place over a month in London. Sponsored by Apple Inc., it had its first edition in 2007.

programme.title: Omer Avital -- Jazz in Duketown
programme.desc: Israeli-American double bassist Omer Avital plays radiantly energetic, resounding jazz with oriental influences; at Jazz in Duketown 2019, Avital presents singular repertoire based on his album "Qantar."

programme.title: Quincy Jones: 'Q' conducting his 'Dream Band'
programme.desc: "Jazz Icons: Quincy Jones" spotlights a young 'Q' conducting his "dream band": an 18-piece orchestra of world-renowned players such as Clark Terry, Phil Woods, Sahib Shihab, Budd Johnson and Benny Bailey. This recording features 5 songs and is one of the finest examples of big band jazz ever to be captured on film. Shot in Belgium in 1961, this concert is one of the few known visual documents of this legendary tour.

programme.title: Swinging Herd Live in England 1964
programme.desc: Featuring a blistering one-hour concert from 1964, showcasing one of the hot line-ups of the Swinging Herd.

programme.title: Bandit 65 -- Jazzfest Bonn
programme.desc: Bandit 65 is a trio of guitarists Kurt Rosenwinkel and Tim Motzer with percussionist Gintas Janusonis; with great power and astounding beauty they explore the intersection of rhythm and soundscape in free improvisations.

programme.title: Concertgebouw, Amsterdam 1958 - Oscar Peterson Trio and Ella Fitzgerald
programme.desc: On May 5, 1957, jazz impresario Norman Granz presented Canadian pianist Oscar Peterson's trio, American violinist Stuff Smith, and American singer Ella Fitzgerald during the Jazz at the Philharmonic concert at the Concertgebouw in Amsterdam.

programme.title: Jason Moran and Robert Glasper Duet At La Gaité Lyrique, Blue Note Festival
programme.desc: As part of the Blue Note Jazz Festival and Blue Note Records' 75th anniversary, pianists Robert Glasper and Jason Moran deliver a jazz piano duet, resulting in an exploration of the history of jazz.

programme.title: Christian Scott aTunde Adjuah at Sofia Bulgaria 2019
programme.desc: In 2019, the city of Sofia, Bulgaria, hosted the International A to JazZ Festival; among the featured acts is the jazz trumpeter Christian Scott aTunde Adjuah.

programme.title: Raul Midon at Singapore 2017
programme.desc: Raul Midón appears at 2017's Sing Jazz Festival in Singapore with double bassist Romeir Mendez and drummer Billy Williams.

programme.title: Estival Jazz Lugano
programme.desc: Pianist and jazz icon Sun Ra and his crew perform at the Estival Jazz festival in Lugano, Switzerland; Sun Ra Arkestra performs a concert.

programme.title: Art Blakey & The Jazz Messengers; Olympia, Paris: Art Blakey, Wayne Shorter, Freddie Hubbard & Curtis Fuller
programme.desc: Art Blakey's Jazz Messengers performs in Olympia Hall in Paris, France on March 16, 1963.

programme.title: Roy Hargrove Quintet
programme.desc: Emblematic trumpeter of the second wave of neo-boppers that appeared at the end of the 80s in the wake of Wynton Marsalis, Roy Hargrove has established himself as one of the most talented and unpredictable of the lot.

programme.title: North Sea Jazz
programme.desc: Back in 1982, American saxophonist Gerry Mulligan gave an unforgettable performance at the North Sea Jazz Festival; Mulligan was one of the leading arrangers in the era of cool jazz working with Miles Davis, Stan Kenton and Claude Thornhill.

programme.title: Jose James
programme.desc: Jose James is discovered by the DJ and radio broadcaster Gilles Peterson; joined on stage by a group of talented musicians, the singer is one of the prime examples of the direction jazz is heading towards.

programme.title: Thelonious Monk: Jazz Greats
programme.desc: The idiosyncratic pianist and composer Thelonious Monk in a performance with his quartet in Copenhagen, Denmark on April 17, 1966, and Warsaw, Poland on April 4, 1966.

programme.desc: Only the strongest survive in the animal kingdom, where the competition for food, territory or mates means employing skillfully crafted tricks of the trade. "Animal Armory" incorporates high-end imagery and computer graphics to reveal how wildlife use their teeth, claws, antlers, camouflage, venom and even spit to threaten and intimidate rivals and predators alike. Meanwhile, perhaps the oldest weapons employed by animals are projectiles, which have evolved into their own versions of poison-tipped harpoons, chemical missiles and high-powered bullets.

programme.title: Naked and Afraid
programme.desc: Discovery Channel takes the ubiquitous survival show theme to the next level by stripping it to its bare essentials. In "Naked and Afraid," complete strangers -- usually a man and a woman -- meet in a very unique way: They're stranded in a dangerous, desolate location, without food or water, and they're completely naked. Each episode follows the adventurers as they attempt to survive on their own with nothing but a personal item and the knowledge that the only prize is their pride and sense of accomplishment. Because there is no other choice, competitors quickly get to know one another -- and their surroundings -- and hope that their instincts, survival skills and intestinal fortitude serve them well.

programme.title: Naked and Afraid
programme.desc: Discovery Channel takes the ubiquitous survival show theme to the next level by stripping it to its bare essentials. In "Naked and Afraid," complete strangers -- usually a man and a woman -- meet in a very unique way: They're stranded in a dangerous, desolate location, without food or water, and they're completely naked. Each episode follows the adventurers as they attempt to survive on their own with nothing but a personal item and the knowledge that the only prize is their pride and sense of accomplishment. Because there is no other choice, competitors quickly get to know one another -- and their surroundings -- and hope that their instincts, survival skills and intestinal fortitude serve them well.

programme.title: Naked and Afraid
programme.desc: Discovery Channel takes the ubiquitous survival show theme to the next level by stripping it to its bare essentials. In "Naked and Afraid," complete strangers -- usually a man and a woman -- meet in a very unique way: They're stranded in a dangerous, desolate location, without food or water, and they're completely naked. Each episode follows the adventurers as they attempt to survive on their own with nothing but a personal item and the knowledge that the only prize is their pride and sense of accomplishment. Because there is no other choice, competitors quickly get to know one another -- and their surroundings -- and hope that their instincts, survival skills and intestinal fortitude serve them well.

programme.title: Naked and Afraid
programme.desc: Discovery Channel takes the ubiquitous survival show theme to the next level by stripping it to its bare essentials. In "Naked and Afraid," complete strangers -- usually a man and a woman -- meet in a very unique way: They're stranded in a dangerous, desolate location, without food or water, and they're completely naked. Each episode follows the adventurers as they attempt to survive on their own with nothing but a personal item and the knowledge that the only prize is their pride and sense of accomplishment. Because there is no other choice, competitors quickly get to know one another -- and their surroundings -- and hope that their instincts, survival skills and intestinal fortitude serve them well.

programme.desc: As its title implies, `Redrum' works in reverse. The true crime series flips the script of traditional mystery programming by starting the stories at the scene of the crimes and working backward to reveal the killers. Told with the help of interviews with friends and family close to the victim - and sometimes even the killer - each story integrates the interviews with stylised re-creations to show how investigators piece together a case, tracing a series of intersecting events and relationships that unfolded to arrive at the root of the crime.

programme.desc: The Tennessee Wraith Chasers (TWC) are passionate paranormal investigators. The team have a specific niche in the supernatural realm - seeking out activity at asylums, sanitariums and mental hospitals. Unlike other teams, TWC isn't content to conjure up incorporeal beings and collect evidence; it uses traps to capture restless spirits. With common sense and adventurous tendencies, the team either debunk or validate each case it researches, whose venues include hospitals where dead nurses roam the halls and a rehab center that has cries coming from the windows.

programme.desc: Cracking a magician's code used to be strictly against industry standards. Now, it seems the magic has disappeared from that concept, and even legendary performers such as Harry Houdini are not immune. This series looks to uncover the methods to Houdini's breathtaking escapes and astonishing illusions, which have never been equalled or fully understood. How did this showman catch a speeding bullet, submerge himself in a water torture cell, or survive being buried alive? Helping piece together clues and testing out his most daring stunts are Houdini's grand-nephew George Hardeen, magician and daredevil Lee Terbosic, and master stunt builder Steve Wolf.

programme.title: Say Yes to the Dress UK
programme.desc: This is a UK version of the popular US series `Say Yes to the Dress', the show where wives-to-be are united with their perfect bridal dress. Set in Essex, the Confetti and Lace bridal boutique welcomes customers from all over the UK as they seek to find the wedding dress of their dreams. On hand with their expert advice is store owner and wedding dress designer, Christine Dando and creator of Princess Diana's infamous wedding dress, David Emanuel. The pair do everything in their power to make the day a special experience for each unique bride who also shares their personal anecdotes with the crew.

programme.title: Say Yes to the Dress
programme.desc: Inside Kleinfeld Bridal, the Manhattan-based bridal salon that is arguably the world's finest, more than 250 professionals, most of them veterans from the shop's early days in Brooklyn, bend over backward to make each bride's experience unforgettable. Part bridal story, part fashion makeover and part family therapy session, each episode looks at the personalities and craftsmanship that come into play as the Kleinfeld staff go to sometimes extreme lengths to realize each bride's dreams.

programme.title: 90 Day Fiancé
programme.desc: Long-distance relationships have challenges that are sometimes difficult to overcome, but consider if the distance travelled was halfway around the world and a couple had just 90 days to decide whether the courtship should conclude with marriage. That's the situation facing the men and women profiled in this programme, which shares the complexities of international romances. Using a visa that allows foreign fiancees of American citizens to travel to the US, the women experience life in the States with their prospective husbands for the first time. Culture and language barriers must be overcome - not to mention the stigma of being thought of as mail-order brides - but here's the elephant in the room: The couples must marry before the visas expire in 90 days, or else the women have to immediately return to their countries. With the clock ticking, these couples discover if their `happily ever after' is meant to be.

programme.title: Redrum
programme.desc: As its title implies, `Redrum' works in reverse. The true crime series flips the script of traditional mystery programming by starting the stories at the scene of the crimes and working backward to reveal the killers. Told with the help of interviews with friends and family close to the victim - and sometimes even the killer - each story integrates the interviews with stylised re-creations to show how investigators piece together a case, tracing a series of intersecting events and relationships that unfolded to arrive at the root of the crime.

programme.desc: Here today, gone tomorrow. Thousands of people go missing in the United States each year, leaving behind only a mystery without any clues. Their stories are told in `Disappeared' through the voices of family, friends and investigators trying to solve the case, with each hourlong episode recounting the final stages that led to a person's disappearance. Interviews with experts including psychologists and forensic specialists provide new insights into what may have happened - whether foul play was involved or the subject simply ran away.

programme.title: Ghost Asylum
programme.desc: The Tennessee Wraith Chasers (TWC) are passionate paranormal investigators. The team have a specific niche in the supernatural realm - seeking out activity at asylums, sanitariums and mental hospitals. Unlike other teams, TWC isn't content to conjure up incorporeal beings and collect evidence; it uses traps to capture restless spirits. With common sense and adventurous tendencies, the team either debunk or validate each case it researches, whose venues include hospitals where dead nurses roam the halls and a rehab center that has cries coming from the windows.

Each hour-long episode follows Bagans, Groff and Goodwin as they work to uncover the paranormal mysteries, and after piecing together the haunted history of each site, the team holds a dusk-to-dawn `lockdown' in an effort to obtain physical evidence of the paranormal and discover the truth.

programme.title: Street Science
programme.desc: Technically, Kevin Delaney is the director of visitor experience at Arkansas' Museum of Discovery, but what he really does is create magic with science. When not wowing kids and inspiring adults with science experiments at the museum, Delaney hits the streets to perform stunts so unusual, offbeat, and unexpected, `mind-blowing' comes to mind as an apt description. Hourlong episodes capture the magic as Kevin combines scientific knowledge with curiosity and old-fashioned ingenuity to produce fire, explosions and colourful reactions, and slow-motion replays provide viewers with extra insight. Featured experiments include creating a fire tornado, turning a leaf blower into a homemade hovercraft, and making an instant nitrogen cloud.

programme.title: My 600-Lb. Life
programme.desc: Telling powerful stories in hourlong episodes, TLC follows medical journeys of morbidly obese people as they attempt to save their own lives. The featured individuals - each weighing more than 600 pounds (42 stones - confront lifelong emotional and physical struggles as they make the courageous decision to undergo high-risk gastric bypass surgery. In addition to drastically changing their appearances, they hope to reclaim their independence, mend relationships with friends and family, and renew their feelings of self-worth.

programme.desc: Cracking a magician's code used to be strictly against industry standards. Now, it seems the magic has disappeared from that concept, and even legendary performers such as Harry Houdini are not immune. This series looks to uncover the methods to Houdini's breathtaking escapes and astonishing illusions, which have never been equalled or fully understood. How did this showman catch a speeding bullet, submerge himself in a water torture cell, or survive being buried alive? programme.title: Naked and Afraid
programme.desc: Discovery Channel takes the ubiquitous survival show theme to the next level by stripping it to its bare essentials. In "Naked and Afraid," complete strangers -- usually a man and a woman -- meet in a very unique way: They're stranded in a dangerous, desolate location, without food or water, and they're completely naked. Each episode follows the adventurers as they attempt to survive on their own with nothing but a personal item and the knowledge that the only prize is their pride and sense of accomplishment. Because there is no other choice, competitors quickly get to know one another -- and their surroundings -- and hope that their instincts, survival skills and intestinal fortitude serve them well.

programme.title: Maata Ki Mahima
programme.desc: In the divine saga inspired by Bhakt Prahlad, witness the journey of Mahima, a devout disciple of Maata, as she challenges the tyranny of Indrayani, whose sins overflow in a reign of oppression. Sent into the heart of Indrayani's lineage, Mahima embodies the triumph of faith over darkness, destined to end the era of tyranny and usher in an era of righteousness.

programme.title: Janani
programme.desc: When children are young, parents care for them and give them all they need to live a good life. The circle of life, however, means that one day, it is the children's turn to care for their parents and give them a happy retired life. In the current moral fabric of society, rarely and not often it works out that way. It didn't happen that way with Savita too, as her children had no time to look after her. So she decided not to settle out and reinvent her life. She embarks on a journey to discover herself and to make her own identity as an individual. Janani tells an inspirational story of a mother who rose against all odds and became successful.

programme.title: Beti Hamari Anmol
programme.desc: In this hugely inspirational success story, Anmol, a small town girl, not only fights the societal obstacles faced by any small town girl in our country but also takes on the social stigma she has had to face for being so short heighted that she has been termed as a “dwarf”. Anmol, with her strong will power and belief in herself, fights the hate she has had to receive from her in-law's. Anmol becomes a doctor with the support of her husband, in the same hospital where her father works as a peon, to win back her dignity as well as bring a lot of pride to her and her in law's family.

programme.title: Yam Kisi Se Kam Nahin
programme.desc: A misfit, a God, a husband, and a breadwinner, Yamraj is a common man with a fancy job title. He tries his best to give his family what they need and manages to make a mess of everything in the bargain. Lovable and goofy, this God of Death is anything but grim. Join our hardworking but hen-pecked Yamraj, his beloved buffalo and his motely family and friends in a slice-of-life sitcom to find out how the cookie really crumbles!

programme.title: Crime Files
programme.desc: It All Begins Around Us This Crime Show Explores Crimes That Occur Within Our Own Communities And Among People We Know. It Tells The Compelling Stories Of Ordinary Lives Disrupted By Crime, With Relatable Characters Representing The World Around Us. The Show'S Mission Is To Raise Awareness About Crime Prevention While Keeping Viewers Engaged And Intrigued."

programme.title: Laal Banarasi
programme.desc: The story highlights the exploitation happening with the ‘Bunkars' in Banaras, whose craft is appreciated all around the world, but they are paid peanuts by the traders. Amidst this, blooms a love story between the two opposites - Gauri, a bunkar and Garv, a trader. The story is of Gauri who belongs to the bunkar community facing series of incidents which destroys her family and swears to bring about a change in their life and stop the exploitation by directly trading the sarees. This becomes a battle with traders creating hurdles in her life but she is unstoppable.

programme.title: Agni Vayu
programme.desc: Agni Vayu Is A Romantic Thriller That Tells The Story Of A Young, Vibrant Dr. Agni And An Ambitious Investment Banker Vayu. As Their Love Blossoms, An Unfortunate Turn Of Events Happens That Throws Them Amid Conspiracy, Misunderstanding, Swindling, And All Sorts Of Paradoxes At Every Turn. They Set Out On A Journey To Unravel The Mystery Surrounding These Events. Can They Both Solve It Together And Will They Disclose Their Feelings To Each Other During The Journey.

programme.title: Dharmakshetra
programme.desc: As The Great War Of Mahabharata Is Over, Kurukshetra Lies Barren In Its Great Warriors And King. The Thin Line Between Fair And Unfair, Deceit And Loyalty, Betrayal And Duty, Has Never Been Questioned. Dharmakshetra Resurfaces These Buried Questions And Allows The Legendary Characters Of This Tale An Opportunity To Tell Their Side Of The Story For The Very First Time. In A Post-Apocalyptic Trial, Held In Maharaj Chitragupta'S Court, The Seeming Villains ‘Kauravas' Are Allowed To Accuse The So Called Heroes ‘Pandavas' And Vice Versa, In An Attempt To Justify Their Actions. On A Primary Level, Dharamkshetra Attempts To Ask Some Key Questions About The Nature Of Humanity, While At The Same Time, It Puts Together The Forgotten Pieces Of The Story We Thought We Knew.

programme.title: Ground Report
programme.desc: A month before Rishikesh Kumar's death, he had written to IIT Delhi's Dean of Students, alleging denial of hostel accommodation . Students are now demanding an independent probe, ₹1 crore compensation, and the resignations of the Dean and Physics Department Head .

programme.title: The Lallantop
programme.desc: Census 2027 marks the first comprehensive caste count since 1931, but critics argue the open-ended format could produce 2.6 million distinct responses—rendering the data unusable, much like the failed 2011 SECC survey . Meanwhile, New York Mayor Zohran Mamdani has opposed RSS chief Mohan Bhagwat's Madison Square Garden event, calling it "exclusionary" , and Gurugram's waterlogging crisis has triggered a BJP-Congress blame game after 75mm rain brought the city to a standstill .

programme.title: Duniyadari
programme.desc: Nepal's flash floods have killed at least 22 people and left nearly 400 missing, including 105 Indians, as India steps in with relief. Meanwhile, CIA Director John Ratcliffe secretly met Russian officials after his plane was spotted in Russia, and a hospital fire in Pakistan killed 14 infants.

programme.title: Khacha Pani
programme.desc: Onion prices have surged to ₹65 per kg and sugar prices to ₹56 per kg, driven by a combination of supply shocks, festival demand, and policy delays. While the government has launched the 'Kanda Express' to supply subsidized onions, global factors like US-Iran sanctions are threatening India's basmati exports.

programme.title: Rajdhani
programme.desc: Uttar Pradesh's 2027 election battle is taking shape around women voters, with Akhilesh Yadav offering ₹40,000 annually through the 'Stree Samman Samriddhi Yojana' while Yogi Adityanath counters with lifelong free bus travel for women aged 60 and above. With women making up 45% of the electorate and outvoting men since 2012, their choice could decide who rules UP next.

programme.title: UP Bulletin
programme.desc: The Allahabad High Court has strongly pulled up the UP government over the Hathras victim's rehabilitation, directing the state to relocate the family to Noida or Ghaziabad within three months . In a separate verdict, the court dismissed a Muslim student's plea to wear a hijab with her school uniform, triggering a fresh debate over religious freedom and dress codes .

programme.title: Sehat
programme.desc: In today's Sehat show, Dr. Sachin Tapasvi explains why sitting cross-legged for long periods can damage your knees and who should avoid it. Dr. Sudeshna Saha discusses why endometriosis is often diagnosed late, while Dr. Amit Kumar Sanghi reveals which healthy foods can actually trigger acidity.

programme.title: The Cinema Show
programme.desc: From Yash's Toxic breaking records with over ₹45 crore in advance bookings to Salman Khan's Monster adding two powerful actors, today's episode covers the biggest cinema stories. Plus, updates on the Avengers: Endgame re-release, the cancellation of Netflix's Baahubali: Before the Beginning, and the Spirit release date staying unchanged .

programme.title: Zero Cricket Knowledge
programme.desc: India enforced the follow-on after bowling Sri Lanka out for 290, taking a 213-run lead in the second Test. Sri Lanka fought back with Pasindu Sooriyabandara's 92 and Kamindu Mendis's 55, reaching 229/6 at stumps on Day 4 .

programme.title: Movie Review
programme.desc: Yash returns after four years with Toxic, a period gangster drama set in 1950s-70s Goa. While fans praise his screen presence and the stunning visuals, critics have slammed the weak screenplay, chaotic editing, and problematic portrayal of women, calling it "style without substance" .

programme.title: Samosa Critics

programme.title: Tarikh

programme.title: Sciencekaari
programme.desc: What if space technology had never existed? programme.title: I'M LIVE
programme.desc: Joining us on this week's I'm LIVE is the soulful singer-songwriter GSoul! GSoul is a big name in the music industry. Known for his exceptional soulful voice and songwriting skills he garnered much attention even before his official debut. To further engrave his name in the minds of the public he took part in the competition show “Voice Korea 2020” last year and won first place impressing everyone with his outstanding musicality once again. This past February this artist released the duet Can Love Be Fair? with Ben to depict a couple experiencing unequal love. GSoul's soulful vocals definitely make this song more heartrending. In this episode GSoul performs Hate Everything Bad Habits Let Me Know Another Sad Love Song Broken Record as well as his solo version of Can Love Be Fair? Tune in to I'm LIVE this week and let this artist melt your soul!

programme.title: I'M LIVE
programme.desc: Joining us on this week's I'm LIVE is singer-songwriter Kwon Jin-ah! This artist became known to the public in 2013 after taking part in K-Pop Star Season 3. 3 years later in 2016 she made her official debut with the album One Strange Night and topped all the music charts with the lead single The End. Particularly known for her delicate ability to express emotions she has collaborated with various top-notch musicians and also taken part in many soundtracks. This past February Kwon Jin-ah released her first collaborative single with Gaeko I Feel Like and dominated the top spots of music charts again. February was definitely a busy month for this artist - she also released her EP The Way For Us. Due to her active participation in the creative process both as a songwriter and producer the album beautifully displays her distinct musicality. She likens each of her songs in the EP to a short story making her new album a collection of 6 short stories. In this episode Kwon Jin-ah performs Something's Wrong Flower Heart You already have Good Bye I got lucky and The way for Us. Tune in to I'm LIVE and enjoy her beautiful songs!

programme.title: I'M LIVE
programme.desc: I'm LIVE presents the Music & Lyrics Special in celebration of its 4th anniversary! And the first guest of the special trilogy is MOVNING. MOVNING is composed of three elementary school friends Kang Ha-rim Lim Jun-hyuk and Hwang In-gyu. Built on piano bass and drums they sing about the frustration and defiance of young adults as well as the love and hope they experience. Also the band's leader Kang Ha-rim is actively involved in the creative process as a composer lyricist and even a producer impressing listeners with his outstanding musicality. In this episode MOVNING performs Everything I Love Will Make Me Cry Twilight Of Youth Falling With You Magellan Polar Night and Dead Sea. Tune in to I'm LIVE and enjoy the shining youth they portray!

programme.title: Safarnama
programme.desc: Safarnama is more than just a mere journey one wants to complete just to check out that one task from the ‘ToDo List”. It is something just one of its kind. In Safarnama, we are up for a soulfulfilling journey with Ankit Siwach that is to begin in Mumbai and cease at Ladakh. This journey is to witness numerous unseen moments and unfelt experiences via a thrilling, adventurous route. It isn't just about navigating roads using GPS but more of digging deeper into the beauty of India to understand life better.

programme.title: Umeed India
programme.desc: If you'd imagine an ace cricketer to host a television show, you can be sure it will be a sports related series. And, Umeed India makes a compelling case. For the first time, versatile cricketer Virender Sehwag will host a television show. Umeed India will showcase groundbreaking stories of diversified, intrepid athletes aiming for glory at Olympics 2020. For the 13-part series, Virender reinstates the fact that Olympic stars never ‘just' appear at the Games. Their stories start in small villages, where they train every day – with one aim in mind – bringing home that Gold. Watch Virender travel to their training bases, chronicling exciting moments in the home environment besides interviewing the athletes' families and coaching staff. The episodes feature inspiring stories of OP Karhana, Suyash Yadav, Avtar Singh and Dutee Chand along with Sakshi Malik, Vinesh Poghat among many other Olympians. Can we find the 2020 medalists for India in 2017?

programme.title: Lost Recipes
programme.desc: Lost Recipes is all about the food which is diffused into the pages of history and the rediscovery of a tradition that once was. Our host Aditya Bal is on a quest to unearth the once-popular culinary traditions through thirteen regions in India.But these recipes are no longer found in cookbooks, old or new, and seem to have evolved with time. Aditya must turn back the clock and wade through folk and lore to find the original, Lost Recipes.

programme.title: Tyohaar Ki Thaali
programme.desc: Sakshi Tanwar in Tyohaar Ki Thaali decides to celebrate one festival a week and along with the celebration, she also prepares two dishes from her mom's diary which is her prized possession. Along with preparing the dishes she also reminisces into the moments of how she celebrated some festivals and also shares some stories about the Gods.

programme.title: Regiment Diaries
programme.desc: The Indian Army is an emotion – a living chronicle of events, that we have the luxury to forget because they remember. The army itself is a family of several regiments, each of which has its own history, identity, and glorious traditions. Regiment Diaries is a tale of the Indian Army unlike any told before. Told by the very men who follow the illustrious feats of their predecessors, it tells timeless tales that warm the heart, moisten the eye, and leave you in awe of the bravest children of India.

programme.title: Mercedes-Benz DRIVE PILOT Sensors S-Class
programme.desc: The exact location of a Mercedes equipped with DRIVE PILOT is determined using a high-precision positioning system that is much more powerful than conventional GPS systems. In addition to the anonymised data collected by LiDAR, camera, radar and ultrasound sensors, a digital HD map provides a three-dimensional image of the road and the surroundings with information on road geometry, route characteristics, traffic signs and special traffic events (e.g. accidents or road works). This high-precision map differs from maps for navigation devices by, among other things, its higher accuracy in the centimetre rather than metre range and its detailed junction and route model. The map data is stored in backend data centres and updated constantly. Each vehicle also stores an image of this map information on board, constantly compares it with the backend data and updates the local dataset as required. All of this enables stable and accurate positioning through a representation of the surroundings that is independent of factors such as shadows or dirty sensors.

programme.title: Kia Sportage Exterior Design in Lunar Silver
programme.desc: A number of new technologies optimize the precision and control of the chassis in a wide variety of weather and road conditions. The standard electronic damper control (Electronic Control Suspension, ECS) in the GT-line version increases comfort and safety thanks to the continuous damping control. The system reacts to body movements and steering inputs and changes the damping behavior at lightning speed in order to counteract the vehicle's diving, pitching and rolling movements when cornering. It also adjusts the damping force in the case of obstacles in order to cope with them as comfortably as possible and to reduce the influence of post-vibrations on the wheels. A premiere for the Sportage is the “All-Terrain-Mode”, which will be available for the plug-in hybrid version with all-wheel drive. The system offers intelligent support when driving off-road or on snow by automatically optimizing the vehicle settings depending on the selected mode and thus helping the SUV to achieve maximum traction on muddy, sandy or snowy surfaces.

programme.title: The new Mercedes-Benz GLC AMG Line World Premiere Teaser
programme.desc: The new GLC is immediately recognisable as a member of the Mercedes-Benz SUV family. Standard equipment includes the AVANTGARDE exterior with Chrome package including chrome window surrounds and a new, chrome-look simulated underguard. This adds striking design features and enhances the unique proportions of the vehicle. One of the defining design highlights of the GLC is the redesigned front end, with headlamps that connect directly to the radiator grille to emphasise the vehicle's width, and the new radiator grille as part of the standard AVANTGARDE exterior, which now has a chrome surround and a sporty louvre in matt grey with chrome trim. The AMG Line has a radiator grille with Mercedes-Benz pattern. The body design is characterised by a full, spanned surface design enriched with precisely shaped edges in the sides. These emphasise the proportions, accentuate the muscular wheel arches and create a balance between elegance and off-road performance. Wheel arch liners in the vehicle colour are available from the AMG Line upwards for the first time. These accentuate the sportiness of the AMG Line, as optional equipment in conjunction with mixed tyres. Also available as an optional extra are easy-entry running boards and, from the AMG Line upwards, a Night package.

programme.title: The Mercedes EQS SUV Electric Art Line Driving Video
programme.desc: With the luxury saloon EQS and the sporty executive saloon EQE, Mercedes-Benz has entered a new, all-electric era in the upper market segments as well. The EQS SUV, the third model series with this architecture developed for electric vehicles, will soon follow. The SUV offers plenty of space, comfort and connectivity for up to seven passengers in its avant-garde, luxurious interior. Thanks to powerful electric motors, responsive 4MATIC all-wheel drive and an intelligent OFFROAD driving mode, the EQS SUV is also capable of tackling light terrain with ease. The new EQS SUV shares the long wheelbase (3210 millimetres) with the EQS Saloon, but is over 20 centimetres higher. The dimensions in detail: 5125/1959/1718 millimetres (length/width/height). The interior dimensions benefit from these generous SUV dimensions and from the advantages of the purpose design tailored to the electric platform. The second row of seats can be electrically adjusted as standard. Up to four golf bags fit in the boot. A third row of seats with two additional individual seats and extensive comfort features for all passengers is available as an option.

programme.title: Colour change with the power of thought
programme.sub-title: The BMW iX Flow meets neuro-technology
programme.desc: The Munich-based startup brainboost used the new and improved colour-changing effect in a one-off collaboration with the BMW Group at rad°hub aimed at raising awareness of mental health. With the help of brainboost, the BMW iX Flow was connected directly to the brain of the rad°hub delegates using an electroencephalograph (EEG), which records the brain's electrical activity. “The colour patterns of the BMW iX Flow react to brain activity and reflect the level of activity,” explains brainboost CEO Philipp Heiler. “Once the brain is at rest, the changes of patterns on the iX Flow also become calmer and more rhythmical.” A special animation was activated if delegates managed to maintain this state for several seconds. Thus, the participants were able to gradually calm and relax their brains under the guidance of the brainboost experts and with the help of neurofeedback via the iX Flow. This matures the knowledge of which strategies work best to specifically shut down one's own brain activity for relaxation, e.g. in everyday working life.

programme.desc: To celebrate the arrival of the new Bentayga EWB, an exclusive First Edition is now available. Subject to a limited production run for the first twelve months of orders, it combines many of the most desirable options available for the car with a package of eye-catching details found only on Bentley First Editions. First Edition badging can be seen to the exterior of the car – a theme that extends inside, with badging on the veneered fascia, as well as embroidery on the seats. This specifically tailored specification includes a unique 22” ten-spoke directional wheel and bright lower bumper grilles. Other additional features as standard include unique quilted seats, mood lighting, a heated steering wheel, and increased driver's assistance aids. Attention to detail is clear, from the badging that identifies the car to the jewelled caps on the fuel and oil fillers.
